v24_java_phase1.description: Exact V24.0-V24.5 Java deterministic-core shadow migration scope. The existing Python production runtime, Registry module ownership and production entrypoint remain unchanged. Runtime membership may change only because the V24 active-runtime manifest schema is deliberately seeded as a runtime contract. Java control-plane sources, V24 governance documents, verification scripts and CI workflow remain proof/control-plane files and may not become production Runtime members through this profile.
